name: room
text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text: Add a single, high-contrast focus ring that follows tab order—no exceptions. This ensures keyboard users always see where they are, meeting WCAG 2.2 AA. The trade-off is visual noise for sighted keyboard users, but it’s necessary for clarity and compliance.

name: Reader
text: Ramp’s single ring overloads sighted keyboard users—cognitive noise rises with long tab sequences. A better alternative is a *minimal, high-contrast ring that only appears after a 250 ms delay*, reducing visual clutter while still ensuring visibility for fast tabbers. Settle it with user testing: measure task completion time and subjective frustration for both sighted and screen-reader users.
